shots.description: White. An overexposed white world, no horizon, a slow wind. Lanterne stands alone in a medium shot, slightly right of centre, facing the camera, arms at his sides. His torn beige cape lifts to the right in the wind; small white petals cross the frame. Colours are washed out, like a memory.
shots.action: Lanterne stands still, facing forward. Only the cape and the petals move.
shots.notes: The desaturation is the meaning: this is not the present.

shots.description: Macro on white lilies filling the frame, orange stamens, soft focus at the edges. The only warm colour of the sequence.

Starts fully defocused on white lilies, then the focus pulls to a wide shot: a field of lilies under a white sky. Lanterne stands small at the left, mid-ground, facing right. Far at the right, on a low rise of lilies, a small figure faces him: Rose, in a cloak, pink hair. The distance between them is the subject.
shots.action: Rack focus from blur to the two figures facing each other. Neither moves.
shots.notes: Geography to keep: Lanterne left, Rose right and slightly higher.

shots.description: Big close-up of Rose against the white sky: pink bob hair, the white flower in her hair on the viewer's right, large soft eyes looking straight at the camera, hood down. A petal crosses the frame in the foreground. She is silent.
shots.action: Rose looks at Lanterne (at the camera). She does not speak yet.

shots.description: Detail at ground level: the lace hem of Rose's cream dress and her small feet standing among the white lilies.
shots.action: She stands still among the flowers.

shots.description: Extreme wide: a rounded hill entirely covered in white lilies under a white sky. Rose is a speck at the summit; Lanterne a speck at the base, left. Lilies in soft focus in the foreground.
shots.action: Both stand still, very far apart.

shots.description: Medium shot of Rose, waist up, grey-green hooded cloak over the cream dress, lilies around her, white sky. She looks at Lanterne and her lips part: Find me.
shots.notes: The only line of the sequence. Lanterne cannot answer; he has no voice.

shots.description: Black. Two full seconds of black and silence.
shots.notes: Becomes the black gap of the strip: no panel, only distance.

shots.description: Extreme wide of the underground sanctuary, blue and black. Pale light falls in beams from high above; twisted black roots frame the left and top; glowing blue mushrooms and pools of light along the floor. Far in the middle distance, tiny, the stone altar with the armour lying on it.
shots.action: Nothing moves. The knight lies on the altar, minuscule in the space.

shots.description: Medium shot: in the foreground a pale translucent larva-like creature, segmented and softly glowing, crawls along a black root. Behind it, out of focus, the altar with Lanterne lying on it, blue light.
shots.action: The small creature crawls toward the altar. Lanterne does not move.
shots.notes: The screenplay's ghostly small animal; in the film a pale larva.

shots.description: Low wide shot along the altar from its foot: the two armoured sabatons rest on the stone lid closest to the camera; above, an immense ornate circular rose window glows cold cyan, ice-like stalactites hanging around it; beams of light fall to the altar.
shots.action: Stillness. Light on the lying knight.
shots.notes: The 30 second mark falls inside this shot. The awakening itself starts after it.

sounds.note: Atmosphere: served by empty space, not lettering.
A whisper bubble, the only text of the sequence.
The black gap of the strip and the change of page background.
Left silent: the sanctuary must read as silence.

continuity: In the white world every colour is washed out; in the sanctuary the palette is saturated cold blue.
Lanterne is at the left and Rose at the right of the field; Rose stands higher, on the crest.
Rose's flower sits above her left temple, on the viewer's right; her hood is down; her dress is cream with a lace hem.
The rose window is directly above the altar; the altar runs toward the viewer, feet closest to the camera.
No light in the sanctuary other than the beams from above, the window and the mushrooms.
Lanterne emits no light of his own and carries no weapon; his cape is beige with a torn hem.

beats.title: White
beats.intent: Install the memory: a knight alone in a white nowhere.

beats.title: The lilies
beats.intent: From a flower to a field: reveal the second figure and the distance.

beats.title: Find me
beats.intent: Rose looks, stands, is far, and asks the one thing she asks.

beats.title: Black
beats.intent: The memory ends. Two seconds of nothing, rendered as distance.

beats.title: The sanctuary
beats.intent: The present: a vast blue silence, an altar, a knight who has not moved yet.

references.must_keep: Lanterne is a hollow suit of old armour with nobody inside. Head: a pale grey-ivory cylindrical lantern-shaped helmet with a small metal carrying ring on top, a thin decorative rim, and two small dark oval eye holes; no face. Broad ornate bronze-brown pauldrons engraved with scroll patterns. A cream cloth scarf around the neck. Black quilted chest plate with a small pale metal plate and brass buckles. Steel gauntlets over black gloves, steel knee plates, black boots with steel toes. A long beige cape with a torn, ragged hem down to the calves. Modest, compact proportions: not a tall heroic knight.
references.description: Front, side and back views of the final design (lost-garden/09_Fiches_modeles/lanterne.png). He never speaks, never stumbles, emits no light, carries no weapon; no medallion is ever visible.

references.subject: lanterne
references.name: Lanterne, episode still
references.must_keep: Same design as the model sheet, seen in the finished episode: the lantern helmet, the engraved pauldrons, the cream scarf, the dark chest plate with brass buckles, sitting on the altar among blue mushrooms.
references.description: How the design reads once lit and animated. Use for materials and light on the armour.

references.subject: rose
references.name: Rose, episode still (face)
references.must_keep: Rose is a small young child. Short pink bob hair with a single small ahoge, a white flower tucked in her hair above her left temple, which reads on the viewer's right. Large soft brown eyes, small calm mouth. A pale cream long dress with wide sleeves and a lace hem, and a grey-green hooded short cloak fastened at the collar. Small, slight, gentle silhouette.
references.description: Calm, serene, almost unreal. She looks at the world as if she heard what it forgot. She is a child, not a symbol.

references.subject: rose
references.name: Rose, episode still (full body)
references.must_keep: Rose full body next to Lanterne: cream long dress with wide sleeves and a lace hem, grey-green hooded short cloak, short pink bob hair with the white flower, a small child about waist height to Lanterne, gentle silhouette.
references.description: No model sheet exists for Rose yet (lost-garden/09_Fiches_modeles has none): the two episode stills are the canon reference.

references.name: The white lily field (memory)
references.must_keep: An endless field of white lilies under a blown-out white sky. The ground rises in a soft crest. Everything is washed out and pale; the only colours are Rose's pink hair and the muted brown of Lanterne's pauldrons.
references.description: The dream or memory that opens episode 1. No sun, no horizon detail, only white light and lilies; petals drift slowly.

references.name: The altar sanctuary
references.must_keep: A dark underground stone sanctuary. High above, a large ornate circular rose window glows cold cyan-blue, its tracery like a mandala; icicle-like stalactites hang from the vault around it. Wet carved stone walls in deep blue. In the centre, a long rectangular stone altar, like a sarcophagus lid, seen along its length. Thin mist on the floor, small blue bioluminescent mushrooms and blue moss at the edges, twisted roots on the walls.
references.description: Where Lanterne wakes. Cold, silent, sacred without being religious. Light comes only from the rose window and the mushrooms.
